desc: Derive and verify the gap transformation: an operation on four consecutive pieces reverses the three gaps, swapping gaps whose 1-based indices differ by 2 and preserving x_1.
Prove reachability: operations are adjacent swaps within the odd-indexed and even-indexed gap subsequences, so all permutations within each parity class are reachable independently.
Implement the O(N log N) Python solution: read input, compute gaps, split by 1-based index parity, sort each parity list ascending, and compute the weighted sum with integer arithmetic.
Validate the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=4, equal gaps, and maximum coordinate values to confirm correctness and absence of overflow.
